## Void Deck 1.3.1

**In-app updates no longer stall at 90 %.** Decky matches the installed folder by the name in `plugin.json`, and
Void Deck was handing it the display name instead. The install finished unpacking but Decky never reported
completion, so the progress bar froze. The installer now passes the plugin name Decky expects, and updates from the
panel complete as they should.

**Every animation now sits on the same dot grid.** The field's background grid was drawn on a 12 px pitch while the
animations were drawn on 8 px, so a second set of rows drifted out of alignment. Both are 8 px now: one lattice, no
stray rows.

**The animations use the whole field.** All eight effects are generated for a taller area and clipped by the hero,
so they reach the left and right edges instead of gathering around the middle.

**Rain falls slower, with trails.** Each drop is now a short vertical streak that fades out along its tail, appears
at the top of the field, falls at about a third of the previous speed and fades out again at the bottom.

**Radar holds its rings.** The rings stay faintly visible between sweeps and each ping trails off, so the effect
reads as a radar instead of blinking dots.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v1.3.1.zip` from this
release. Or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
